TODAY’S STORIES

Lawmakers are pushing the KIDS Act, a controversial new bill that could force you to hand over your government ID and facial scans just to log into social media. While framed as a child safety measure, critics are sounding the alarm over massive privacy risks and the creation of centralized identity databases. We also dive into Republicans gaslighting Americans over affordability, Tim Walz' controversial pardon, Tucker Carlson starting a third party after his fight with Trump, and more
